Objection.title: Objection
Objection.description: A cryptographically sealed public objection or regulatory violation dossier (such as expired medicine, expired food, price gouging, or public safety hazard) tracked by a unique tracking number and verified by regulatory authorities.

trackingId.description: Unique tracking identifier formatted as OBJ-2026-XXXXXX.

title.description: Concise summary headline of the objection.

severity.description: Risk severity tier assessed from expiration delta and public exposure.

status.description: Current regulatory verification and enforcement lifecycle stage.

visibility.description: Access visibility tier for query enforcement.

establishmentName.description: Name of pharmacy, supermarket, manufacturer, or civic entity.

jurisdiction.description: City, district, or regional regulatory jurisdiction.

batchNumber.description: Printed batch, lot, or serial identifier on the product or site.

expiryDate.description: Printed expiration date on the medicine or food product (YYYY-MM-DD).

description.description: Detailed factual statement of the objection and observed hazard.

sha256Hash.description: Hex-encoded 64-character SHA-256 integrity digest of the dossier payload.

isEncrypted.description: Whether an AES-256-GCM encrypted confidential whistleblower note is attached.

encryptedPayload.description: Base64-encoded AES-256-GCM ciphertext of confidential witness/supply-chain evidence.

encryptionIv.description: Base64-encoded 96-bit initialization vector for AES-256-GCM decryption.

mediaType.description: Type of attached visual inspection evidence.

mediaUrl.description: URL or encoded data URI of attached photo or video evidence.

mediaCaption.description: Documentary caption describing the attached photo or video evidence.

authorId.description: Authenticated UID of the submitting citizen.

reporterAlias.description: Publicly safe display alias or pseudonymous citizen identifier (no PII).

authorityBadgeId.description: Official badge/credential ID of the verifying regulatory inspector.

authorityNote.description: Official laboratory or field inspection verification report.

enforcementAction.description: Official regulatory directive, recall notice, or penalty issued.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the objection was originally sealed.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest verification or update.

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted regulatory authority administrator record used for RBAC verification.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin credential was registered.

/objections/{objectionId}.description: Primary ledger of public objections, expired medicine/food reports, and authority verification states.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Trusted registry of regulatory authority administrators.
